title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: precast seating
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Precast seating tiers
swms.task: Install the precast concrete seating tiers onto the raker beams with the crane company's crawler crane, working on the sloping bowl more than 2 m above the ground.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection is fixed to each tier edge as the units are placed. Riggers landing units at the open end work on travel restraint lines to engineer designed anchors set so they cannot reach the edge.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.tierErection: Units are placed to the engineer's erection design PC-301 (revision C): bearing pads and fixings as detailed, placed in the sequence shown, with temporary propping where the design shows it, checked by the precast supervisor before the hook is released.

steps: Work with the crane crew during lifts
Place precast seating units on the rakers

rules.phrase: no gap over 450 mm between rails
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 306E
rules.quote: not over 450mm between any rail and its nearest rail or between the lowest rail and any toe board
